# What Each Cell Is For

> A live, read-only view of every cell standing on this machine that
> works on a quest: the purpose its quest states, the cell that started it
> and the cells it started, and how far the plans, research, briefs and reports it keeps have come.

- [The page](index.html): the cells drawn as the forest floor cut
  through, then listed, each under the cell that started it, walked by
  keyboard or pointer, with the cell the cursor is on beside them.
- [The page as text](index.md): how to read it, the keys, and what the
  data holds.
- The data: the mycelium node's `forage` records, which the page
  watches live over the sites' server at /feed/node. An agent on the
  machine runs `mycelium forage -o json` itself, which gathers the
  realm's cells, not only this machine's.
- [The map](../mycelium/): every cell and the networks they share.
- [All his sites](../llms.txt): the home this page sits in.
